lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; f1040s1a (2025), line 36a: "If you have a valid social security number (see instructions) and were born before January 2, 1961, enter the amount from line 35", with the spouse on line 36b; i1040gi p. 33, Line 12d, separates the boxes for you and for your spouse. sa.age65 is the published question "Were you born before January 2, 1961?" for you alone (its consumer is Schedule 1-A line 36a); the candidate reads it as whether any line 12d box (age or blindness, yours or a joint spouse's) is checked. The 17 completed-return value differences (project false, candidate true) are returns where you were not born before January 2, 1961 but your joint spouse was, or (classm.tcw.16) your spouse is blind: classm.f8962.5.deepseek (spouse age 65 or older, you not), classm.f8962.5.gpt, classm.scveh.1, classm.tcw.16, mutation.t2.f8962_months_asset3, generated returns 208, 254, 255, 290, 366, 373, 395 and 476, and four partial records of classm.f8962.5.gpt (sa.spouse_extra, sa.spouse_itemizes, sa.elect_itemize or sa.gambling_losses withheld). Triage executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sa.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 526 partial records from 40 bases; 2,521 comparisons): 2,427 agree; differences 17 candidate-unknown, 77 value; on completed returns 17 value; every completed-return witness enumerated by an uncapped scratch rerun of the same evaluator (the record keeps 6 per kind). Project stands.

Ruling: representation; equivalent on executable triage, ruled mechanically: the project's line and the reply's agree on every input triage ran (3757 values compared, none different or missing: 2028 on 2028 fixture cases, 500 on 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 1229 on 1229 partial records; policy executable-triage-v2). No agent read the source; one in 10 such disagreements is held for adjudication instead.

Ruling: representation; the reply's three conditions (line 18 election, a separate return whose spouse itemizes, itemized total over the standard deduction; tie to the standard deduction) are the project's (i1040gi p. 33, Line 12e; p. 34, Exception 2; f1040sa line 18). The reply reads sa.spouse_itemizes outside the separate-return gate and reaches each Schedule A amount directly. Triage 8d1c7332dffb: 3,228/4,083 agree with no value difference: 702 candidate-unknown (inputs such as sa.gambling_losses and sa.home_other that the interview did not ask), 115 candidate-refuses and 22 project-refuses (a refusal reached on one side only, on refused or incomplete returns), 16 project-unknown (sa.excluded_income unanswered on incomplete returns).

Ruling: representation; project retained. Both select line 17 when itemizing is elected, when a separate-return spouse itemizes, or when line 17 is more than the standard deduction, and the standard deduction otherwise (i1040gi p. 34, Line 12e; p. 33, Line 12b; f1040sa line 18); the reply writes it as the larger of the two unless the election is made, which gives the same amount on a tie. As ruled before, the reply reads the spouse-itemizes answer outside the separate-return gate. This pass reviewed the line because lane fx-itemized added the refusal sa.charity_over_if_itemizing (Pub. 526 p. 22, no more than 60% of AGI; p. 25, capital gain property 30%), which is not part of the compared expression. No change to the data.

Ruling: representation; the project's choose (mfs -> sa.spouse_itemizes, else sa.no false) is the reply's all(status = mfs, spouse_itemizes) (i1040gi p. 34, Exception 2). Triage 8d1c7332dffb: 4,082/4,083 agree; the one difference is project-unknown on a refused return that never answers f1040.status.

Ruling: model error; i5329 p. 5, exception 05, "Qualified retirement plan distributions up to the amount you paid for unreimbursed medical expenses during the year minus 7.5% of your adjusted gross income (AGI) for the year", which applies whether or not the filer itemizes. The reply asks line 1 only on the medical ticks; the one completed difference is advland.retirement.e05_medical_asked (exception 05 claimed, medical tick not ticked: project $15,000, reply $0), hand-predicted from that text (BUG-1195). Triage executable-triage-v2 (.transcription/triage/2025/sa.json, pass a2bc9f183177): 4409 of 4410 agree; {"value": 1}; completed {"value": 1}. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; project retained. i1040sca p. 6, Line 5b, 'Enter on line 5b the state and local taxes you paid on real estate you own that wasn't used for business'; p527 p. 25, Personal Use of Dwelling Unit (Including Vacation Home), 'Only your rental expenses may be deducted on Schedule E (Form 1040). Some of your personal expenses may be deductible on Schedule A (Form 1040) if you itemize your deductions'. The reply takes the filer's line 5b answer (less the part left out) and nothing else. The project asks the filer to leave out the tax on a property rented out for 15 days or more (except days it was the filer's home before or after renting it) and adds, for each rental reported on Schedule E, the part of its tax not taken there (rental.amt16 less rental.line16; BUG-1203), so the same tax is neither counted twice nor lost. With no reported rental, or one with no personal use, the two agree (fixture fxi.rental_tax_personal_to_5b shows the difference: $142.86 added). No change to the data.

Ruling: representation; equivalent: i1040sca p. 8, Line 8a. The reply reads sa.home_other and sa.home_owner together; the project asks sa.home_other only when sa.home_owner is No (the parent question) and reads sa.mortgage_interest when either is Yes, the same condition. Triage executable-triage-v2 (pass a9e1a8c8fc0e): 3,572 of 3,757 agree and no value differs; 184 candidate-unknown are the reply's mortgage credit screen reading s3.mcc where the interview has not asked it (e.g. classm.sd.3.deepseek, project $0); 1 candidate-refuses (redesign.credits.refuse.mcc: the reply refuses on line 8a, the project at Schedule 3 line 7 through s3.mcc_if_interest; the return refuses in both). Project stands.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. With no gambling winnings line 8b is zero, so the smaller of the losses and line 8b is zero, which the project writes as an explicit zero; with winnings both give the losses up to line 8b (i1040sca p. 11, Other Itemized Deductions, gambling losses 'but only to the extent of gambling winnings reported on Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 8b'). The project's guard reads s1.gambling_winnings, which s1.line8b copies. Same disagreement as ruled before; re-reviewed only as a reader of the changed lines. No change to the data.

Ruling: finding; medium; the reply adds Schedule 1 line 8u to earned income and the project does not. i1040gi p. 35, Standard Deduction Worksheet for Dependents, footnote: "Generally, your earned income is the total of the amount(s) you reported on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 1z, and Schedule 1, lines 3, 6, 8r, 8t, and 8u minus the amount, if any, on Schedule 1, line 15." amb.2025.sa_dep_earned left 8u out because it was refused upstream; lane x2-s1o now computes s1.line8u, so a dependent filer with inmate wages gets too small a line 2. The reply's 'more than $900' branch equals the project's larger_of(earned + $450, $1,350) (amb.2025.sa_dep_earned). Triage 8d1c7332dffb shows no value difference (no dependent filer with line 8u in fixtures or generated returns): 3,521 candidate-hides-shown (the reply shows the worksheet only when sa.dependent), 309 project-refuses, 136 project-unknown, 36 candidate-unknown. (BUG-0767)
